findingsAddressed.result: Actual image reads14:00–16:00 in RTL. Shared context remains right-aligned. Retry emits exactly one retry; bottom reached.

findingsAddressed.change: Give the panel and nested confirmation card explicit accessibility containment before setting their container identifiers, preventing inheritance from replacing descendant IDs.
findingsAddressed.result: Rows, controls, text/context and containers retain distinct required native IDs. Confirmation and reference are distinct. Scripted native targets resolve uniquely and activations execute. Loading/unavailable modes were not recaptured during this interval.

findingsAddressed.change: Remove the accessibilityElement(children:.ignore) replacement around each Button; retain native Button role/disabled state and add only selected trait and coherent label.
findingsAddressed.result: Rows expose native role_raw9. Unavailable s10 is enabled=false and blocked with no event. Eligible f09 emits select_slot:f09 once; repeated selected activation emits none; confirm emits confirm:f09. Selected rows remain selected=true.

findingsAddressed.change: Replace PlainButtonStyle with a small native ButtonStyle that preserves the specified idle palette and applies opacity only while pressed. Native disabled semantics remain on the actual Button.
findingsAddressed.result: Light unavailable row dominant foreground/fill pixels areRGB82,97,116 /244,246,249. Light disabled confirm isRGB102,112,133 /228,231,236. Dark disabled confirm isRGB184,196,212 /52,64,84. These match the public tokens and eliminate the extra disabled fade.

findingsAddressed.change: Add vertical padding around Toggle, a full rectangular content shape, and a36pt minimum label height so content plus padding supplies at least44pt without replacing native toggle semantics.
findingsAddressed.result: Native switch remains role_raw40 with frame256×44.6667pt. Value changes0→1 after one fee_accepted:true callback; confirmation enables and emits confirm:e17. Selecting e08 emits once and hides consent. Physical edge-hit testing was not performed.

findingsAddressed.change: The identifier/control repairs allow common native scripted actions to execute instead of stopping at missing target searches.
findingsAddressed.result: Observed native select/selected-repeat/fee/confirm/Done actions now have callback evidence. Done emits exactly once. Disabled activations are blocked. iOS Retry was not recaptured.
